name: Seated Spinal Rotation

instructions.description: Sit tall near the front of a chair with both feet planted firmly on the floor.
Place one hand on the opposite thigh and the other hand on the chair back.
Gently rotate your rib cage to one side while keeping the pelvis mostly facing forward.
Hold with easy breathing, return to center, and repeat to the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a comfortable thoracic rotation range without forcing the neck.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Rotate the trunk while lying on the floor for more support.

commentsNotes: Avoid using your arms to crank into the twist.
